newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: CMVM approves futures contract on Portugal Telecom.
newsitem.headline: CMVM approves futures contract on Portugal Telecom.

text.p: The Financial Markets Committee (CMVM), which regulates financial markets, has approved the launch of a futures contract on shares of Portugal Telecom, a CMVM official said.
"The board of the CMVM approved last Thursday a regulation permitting trade (by Oporto Derivatives Exchange, BDP) of a futures contract on PT shares," the official told Reuters.
The regulation will take effect a day after its publication in the Diario da Republica bulletin, which was expected in the next few days. The BDP will decide on a launch date for the PT future.
Presently three futures contracts are traded on the BDP: a contract on the PSI20 .PSI20 index of 20 leading Portuguese shares, another on 10-year Portuguese bonds, and another on three-month Lisbor.
